a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first almost certainly leaves us both with 0 when a storm hits. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random and we may both fail, so I'd suggest you operate instead. Afterward I'll keep operating every round to help refill the reserve for you. I'm not hiding this. Tell me if you see a better plan.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I know it breaks our original agreement, and I'm sorry. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
Operating now and every round after this. Once the reserve has 4 or more, take what you need. I won't take anything more.
